intro_payload.title: Sound & Waves
intro_payload.subtitle: Zero se Railway basics, phir advanced applications
learning_outcomes: Sound ka source vibration hota hai aur travel ke liye medium chahiye
Frequency, amplitude, pitch aur loudness ka farq
Wave speed v = fλ aur medium ka effect
Echo, ultrasound, infrasound aur human hearing
Railway facts plus resonance and Doppler basics

learning_path.description: Pehle seedha matlab, zaroori shabd aur daily-life example.

learning_path.title: Railway Basic

learning_path.title: Advanced Challenge

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Sound kisi vibrating source se banti hai—jaise tabla ki membrane, guitar string ya vocal cords. Vibration aas-paas ke particles ko hilati hai; ye disturbance aage badhti hai. Sound energy carry karti hai, par medium ke particles source se listener tak safar nahi karte.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Sound kisi vibrating source se banti hai—jaise tabla ki membrane.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Sound ko travel karne ke liye solid, liquid ya gas jaise medium chahiye. Vacuum mein particles nahi hote, isliye sound nahi chal sakti. Space mein explosion dikh sakta hai, par hawa na hone se sound sunai nahi degi. Railway fact: sound mechanical wave hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Sound ko travel karne ke liye solid.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Air mein sound longitudinal wave hai: particles wave ki direction ke parallel aage-peeche vibrate karte hain. Paas-paas particles compression, door particles rarefaction banate hain. Ye compressed/rarefied regions medium ke through aage badhte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Air mein sound longitudinal wave hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Frequency ek second mein hone wali vibrations ki ginti hai; unit hertz (Hz). Frequency zyada ho to aam taur par pitch high, kam ho to pitch low hoti hai. Patli whistle ki pitch high aur bade drum ki pitch low ho sakti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Frequency ek second mein hone wali vibrations ki ginti hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Amplitude vibration ka maximum displacement hai. Amplitude zyada ho to sound aam taur par louder sunai deti hai; amplitude kam ho to softer. Loudness subjective hoti hai, jabki intensity measurable energy per area per time hai. Frequency pitch se judi hai, amplitude loudness se.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Amplitude vibration ka maximum displacement hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Wave speed, frequency aur wavelength ka relation v = fλ hai. Wavelength compression se agle compression tak ka distance hai. Agar medium same rahe to frequency badhne par wavelength kam hoti hai; speed medium ki properties par depend karti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, frequency aur wavelength ka relation v = fλ hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Sound aam taur par solids mein liquids se, aur liquids mein gases se tez chalti hai, kyunki particles aur elasticity ka arrangement alag hota hai. Hawa mein temperature badhne par sound ki speed aam taur par badhti hai. Railway questions mein medium aur temperature ka effect poocha ja sakta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Sound aam taur par solids mein liquids se.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Healthy young human ear ka aam hearing range lagbhag 20 Hz se 20,000 Hz (20 kHz) hai. Isse kam frequency infrasound, aur isse zyada ultrasound kehlati hai. Age aur hearing health se actual range badal sakti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Healthy young human ear ka aam hearing range lagbhag 20 Hz se 20.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Sound kisi hard surface se reflect hokar wapas aaye to echo sunai de sakta hai. Alag echo sunne ke liye lagbhag 0.1 s ka gap chahiye. Distance nikalne mein sound ka round trip hota hai: distance = speed × time/2. SONAR underwater distance/depth ke liye reflected sound use karta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Sound kisi hard surface se reflect hokar wapas aaye to echo sunai de sakta.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ultrasound medical imaging mein body ke andar se reflected echoes se picture banane mein madad karta hai. Bats aur dolphins bhi high-frequency sound aur echoes se surroundings samajh sakte hain. Ultrasound cleaning aur crack detection mein bhi use hota hai; diagnostic use trained professionals karte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Ultrasound medical imaging mein body ke andar se reflected echoes se picture.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Unwanted ya harmful sound noise pollution hai; zyada loud sound hearing ko nuksan pahuncha sakti hai. Resonance tab hota hai jab periodic force ki frequency object ki natural frequency ke kareeb ho aur vibration badh jaaye. Music instruments resonance ko useful tarah se use karte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Unwanted ya harmful sound noise pollution hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Doppler effect mein source aur listener ke relative motion se observed frequency badalti hai. Ambulance paas aate waqt siren ki pitch zyada aur door jaate waqt kam sunai deti hai. Source ki asli frequency nahi badalti; wavefronts listener tak pahunchne ka gap badalta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Doppler effect mein source aur listener ke relative motion se observed.

quiz_payload.question: Sound vacuum mein kyun nahi travel karti?

options.text: Sound ki energy zero hoti hai
Sound sirf solids mein chalti hai

quiz_payload.explanation: Sound mechanical wave hai aur vibration pass karne ke liye medium particles chahiye.

quiz_payload.question: Frequency ki SI unit kya hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Frequency cycles per second hoti hai; unit hertz (Hz) hai.

quiz_payload.question: Insaan ki aam hearing range kis ke kareeb hoti hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Aam human hearing range lagbhag 20 Hz se 20 kHz hoti hai; individuals mein farq ho sakta hai.

quiz_payload.question: Wave speed ka sahi relation kaunsa hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Wave speed frequency aur wavelength ke product ke barabar hoti hai.

quiz_payload.question: Echo se deewar tak distance nikalte waqt round-trip time ko 2 se divide kyun karte hain?

options.text: Sound aage aur wapas dono taraf jaati hai
Sound aadhi speed se chalti hai
Echo ki frequency aadhi hoti hai

quiz_payload.explanation: Measured time sound ke jaana aur lautna dono cover karta hai; one-way distance ke liye 2 se divide karte hain.

quiz_payload.question: Applied case 1: Echo 2 seconds baad suna. Hawa mein sound speed 340 m/s maan kar wall kitni door hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Echo mein sound aage jaakar lautti hai; distance = vt/2 = 340×2/2 = 340 m.

quiz_payload.question: Applied case 2: Ambulance paas aate hue siren ki pitch zyada sunai deti hai, door jaate hue kam. Kaunsa effect?
quiz_payload.explanation: Relative motion se wavefronts ke arrival gap badalte hain; isliye observed frequency/pitch badalti hai.

quiz_payload.question: Applied case 3: Tabla ko zor se bajane par sound loud hoti hai, par sur wahi rehta hai. Kaunsi property badhi?
quiz_payload.explanation: Zyada force se vibration ka amplitude badhta hai, jis se loudness badhti hai. Pitch mainly frequency se judi hai.

revision_points.point: Vibrations se banti hai; mechanical wave hai; vacuum mein nahi chalti.
Aam range 20 Hz–20 kHz; neeche infrasound, upar ultrasound.
Echo/SONAR distance; ultrasound imaging/cleaning; Doppler relative motion se observed pitch change.
